children: outlined its fiscal 2029 financial targets today during its Investor Forum, including a revenue CAGR of 30% from 2026 through 2029 and a free cash flow margin of 20%.

The high-speed connectivity company also expects an adjusted gross margin of 50% and an adjusted operating margin of 32% to 25%. It guided for full-year fiscal 2027 revenue to range from $8.3B to $8.4B, which implies year-over-year growth of at least 30%.

"The three-year financial targets announced today reflect both the opportunities we see ahead and our confidence in our ability to execute," said Ciena CFO Marc Graff. "Backed by a differentiated portfolio, growing customer demand, expanding supply capacity, and new addressable market opportunities, we are well-positioned to deliver sustained revenue growth, significant profitability expansion, and attractive returns for our owners over the coming years."

The company is also changing its financial reporting segments starting with the first quarter of fiscal 2027. The new segments include Optical Systems, Interconnects, Global Services, and Routing and Other. It is expected to provide investors with more clarity on financial performance.
Trading on Ciena was temporarily halted just before 2 p.m. ET on Wednesday afternoon due to "news pending." Trading resumed shortly after 2 p.m. with shares up about 3%.
Optical names were trending up during Wednesday afternoon trading. Coherent

title: Ciena reveals 30% revenue CAGR target through 2029; optical names climb
